text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *all* PRs for two weeks first. This gives us real data on how it behaves without disrupting workflows. The trade-off is delayed automation gains, but we avoid risky blind spots in our first controlled test. After two weeks, we’ll have clean metrics to decide if full A/B testing is worth the effort.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode won’t catch PR-Agent’s worst flaw: false negatives. It won’t flag real risks because it only watches what passes the PR process—meaning we’d miss the critical gaps in review. Instead, run a parallel audit: have a human reviewer blind-spot-check a random sample of PRs during shadow mode. If the human flags issues PR-Agent missed, we’ll know the tool’s blind spots before trusting it. Settle the argument with a two-week test where we compare PR-Agent’s misses to the human audit’s hits.

name: Overhaul
text: Run the human blind-spot audit on *only* the first 100 PRs in shadow mode—cheaper than sampling forever, fast to spot systemic gaps early. If it finds no major issues, drop the audit and scale PR-Agent to all PRs immediately.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on all PRs for two weeks while running a human blind-spot audit on the first 100 PRs. This gives us real-world data on both false positives and false negatives without disrupting workflows. The trade-off is slightly higher upfront effort, but it prevents systemic gaps from slipping through while keeping the test controlled. After two weeks, we’ll have clear metrics to decide whether to scale PR-Agent or adjust the audit scope.

name: Ratchet
text:
DECISION: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on all PRs for two weeks while conducting a human blind-spot audit on the first 100 PRs to catch false negatives early.

Result: Clean metrics on PR-Agent’s false positives and false negatives without workflow disruption, plus early detection of systemic review gaps.

Owner: Sprocket.
